objective: Remove the final compatibility-only authentication/session residue after public URL access was promoted, so the active Ron System client/server contain no token/login/logout/session bootstrap path while preserving URL-only access, System action integrity, player projection, PWA install/offline behavior, push, and Git rollback provenance.

roles_before.artifact: Fresh clients already access System Core without credentials.
server-v2 exposes a no-op /api/v1/session endpoint and app-v2/index retain compatibility code/stubs for cached authenticated clients.
Service worker v17 caches the active shell.
Idempotency, action/schema validation, PostgreSQL gate and evidence/gameplay policy constrain mutations.
Quest/profile/progression/notification/shop rendering and navigation operate independently of authentication.
PR #55 base and Git history preserve the removed authenticated and compatibility implementations.

role_dispositions.destination: Canonical URL remains sufficient for PWA/API access on any device.

role_dispositions.rationale: Ron explicitly requires complete zero-credential access and does not want dormant bearer/password/session compatibility paths retained in active runtime.
role_dispositions.consequence: Old pre-public cached clients must refresh to the current shell instead of using /api/v1/session; the service-worker cache bump forces current shell replacement.

role_dispositions.destination: ron-system-shell-v18 evicts prior shell caches and explicitly caches challenge-timing-view.js imported by app-v2.
Idempotency, action validation, DB gate, evidence/lifecycle/gameplay rules remain unchanged.
All non-auth app-v2 rendering, actions, navigation, push and refresh behavior is preserved; offline state replaces locked/login state.
Git history and PR #55 retain exact prior implementations.

capability_probes.assertion: POST /api/v1/session returns 404 while anonymous capabilities/snapshot/actions continue to work.
Active PWA source/HTML contains no token dialog, legacy token migration, login/logout/session route calls or locked/auth copy.
Capabilities and snapshot stay anonymously readable and valid actions still pass the unchanged idempotent action gate.
Base SHA a48287eee37a3c9322a28d8d8439be4a8433d5ed and Git history recover compatibility behavior if explicitly needed.

tests.expected: PASS: no active token/session/login compatibility source remains and service-worker cache is v18.
PASS: /api/v1/session=404, anonymous snapshot/capabilities/action behavior remains valid.

known_intentional_losses: Cached pre-public clients can no longer call the compatibility /api/v1/session endpoint; they must load the current v18 shell.
There is no login/logout/session UI or authentication-specific offline state in the active PWA.

verification.authorization: Ron explicitly instructed complete removal of bearer tokens, passwords, login/session gates and remaining compatibility residue so possession of the canonical URL alone provides System access.
